results.content: 🚀 What happens when multiple AI coding agents work on the same project? Things can get messy. Agents may edit the same files, overwrite changes, and create frustrating merge conflicts. That's exactly the problem AgentMash is trying to solve. Meet agentmash – an open-source multiplayer AI collaboration platform that helps your team's coding agents work together without stepping on each other's code. Here's what makes it interesting: 🔹Shared Context: Every AI agent knows what other agents are changing. 🔹Fewer Conflicts: Agents get notified before editing files that teammates are already working on. 🔹Multiple AI Models: Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more. 🔹Team Collaboration: Chat with teammates and even mention their AI agents, just like Slack. 🔹Smarter Workflows: Keep [...] their AI agents, just like Slack. 🔹Smarter Workflows: Keep tasks, conversations, skills, and automations connected. The results shared by AgentMash are impressive: 📊 98.6% of overlapping work caught before conflicting edits. 📊 Integration conflicts reduced from 17.5% to 4.7% in their benchmarks.
